minutes.headline: Board ratified Lt. Tibido as interim police chief; most special town meeting articles held a week, Marshall Park debt opposed.
minutes.summary: The board ratified the interim police chief appointment and honored the retiring chief with a proclamation. It approved two toll booth requests, an agricultural commission appointment, a tax title policy amendment, and executive session minutes. It then reviewed the special town meeting warrant, recommending a few articles and holding most for a week. Marshall Park borrowing and the salary plan drew the strongest concerns, and the St. Mary in Christ license hearing was continued.

public_comment.topic: A resident reminded the public to check smoke and carbon monoxide detectors as the heating season starts.
Asked the town manager to look into the cemetery commission not meeting since July, and urged boards to hold extra meetings to meet deadlines.

what_happened.line: The Select Board ratified Lt. Jeffrey Tibido as interim chief of police, effective Oct 18, and authorized the interim town manager to sign the contract.
The board recommended five special town meeting articles, including Mart Connect transportation, tax exemption clauses and a Council on Aging revolving fund.
Most remaining warrant articles were held until next Tuesday, among them the school budget amendment, the late bill, the salary plan and the Marshall Park borrowing.
The board amended its tax title policy, approved two toll booth requests and appointed a member to the agricultural commission.
The hearing on the St Mary in Christ all-alcohol license was continued to next Tuesday at 7:15 p.m. after the other license transfers were approved.

why_it_matters: Residents will vote on these articles at special town meeting, and the board's recommendations on the held articles, including borrowing for Marshall Park and the school appropriation, are not yet set.
The tax rate, new growth and free cash were not certified before the meeting, so the levy limit the articles are voted against is unknown.
